content.rendered:
Multi-material MRF (Material Recycling Facility) systems from Van Dyk blend conventional low-maintenance technology with highly automated machinery capable of processing almost any type of incoming material. A Multi-MRF will increase your throughput and replace any existing manual sorting operations. More automation allows processing of higher volumes of materials at your material recovery facility without increasing labor costs.

Multi-material MRF systems

A Bollegraaf sorting system can efficiently process multiple waste streams over a single processing line. Innovative technology allows the same line at your MRF to switch between different waste streams, including dirty commercial waste, multi-family, MSW, C&D, and residential single stream.

Our key technologies for Material Recovery Facilities:

  • TOMRA sensor based sorting maximizes recovery and product purity.
  • Walair density separation delivers increased system capacity and flexibility.
  • 3-D trommel screens lead the industry in system uptime rates.

Waste streams at our customers’ MRFs include:

  • Dirty commercial
  • Multi-family
  • MSW
  • Mixed waste
  • C&D
  • Residential single stream

Our MRF delivers:

  • High capacity
  • High recovery
  • Minimal manual labor

This recent MRF system processes both residential single stream and commercial waste:
